verdict.rationale: Homebrew publishes package metadata through formulae.brew.sh, so event notifications such as new-version or formula-change webhooks are a fair question for it. The evidence documents only a static, unauthenticated JSON data API that must be polled. Nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or an event-subscription mechanism, and a polling API is an adjacent feature, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
